_comment: SAFE fixture for BROKER mode (BOSUN-SERVE.md §3c, docs/ENSURE-AND-LOCATE.md). Every row is a harmless `python3 -m http.server` or a `nc -lU` unix socket under /tmp — no real-rig service is touched. Ports 8180-8189 are reserved for this fixture. Stand a scratch router beside the live one with BOSUN_SERVE_STATUS_PORT=3996 so the two do not fight over :3997. Not golden-pinned — edit freely.

servers.description: BROKER, rewritable. The itajara shape: the router moves it to :28180, holds :8180 to answer 307, and /where hands back ws://127.0.0.1:28180. Bosun never carries a byte.
BROKER, NOT rewritable — the literal port is not in the command. A refusal under proxy rules; here the service simply keeps :8181, the router binds nothing, and /where is the only door.

BROKER over a UNIX SOCKET — the es9-daemon / fh2-daemon shape. No port at all, so the proxy model cannot see this row (NoHostPort); broker ensures it and reports the socket path, readiness by the socket file existing.

BROKER over UDP — the link-spike shape. Located but deliberately NOT probed: a TCP connect against a datagram socket proves nothing, so `probe` reads `none` (nothing was checked) rather than a fabricated verdict.
NO serveMode — the control. Proxied exactly as every row was before broker mode existed: the router holds :8183 and relays to :28183.
